scope: Read-only preflight of Root-authored diagnostic subprocess harness. No harness, CLI, ptrace, Cargo, build, QEMU or Git execution by reviewer; no repository/source modifications.
author_boundary: Reviewer previously authored output.rs/logging components and a narrow support-script cache fix. Root authored this new runner; this is cross-source review, not complete independent product implementation acceptance.
initial_findings_resolved: FD must be statted through its proc magiclink; resolved pathname is independently compared. Held/final same-inode proof added.
Check80-byte syscall entry/33-byte exit plus audit ABI and actual error bit.
Preserve primary gate failure before secondary cleanup; retain pidfd and do not let generic Popen.poll interpret ptrace stop as exit.
Handle pidfd initialization failure and early terminal bootstrap wait; bound startup wait.
Distinguish clone/exec event stops, identify newborn SIGSTOP via GETEVENTMSG, forward genuine signals.
Measure hold after actual requested-signal forwarding; keep original same-syscall result.

source.needle: ordinary non-setuid Linux native caller required

static_checks.conclusion: Requires Linux x86_64/aarch64 with nonzero equal real/effective UID; no root/hostUSB/module/backend mutation by the test.
Only the explicitly selected prebuilt ELF and two fixed same-PID exec wrappers are launched. PIPE/stdin/close_fds/env/cwd are explicit.
Retain the original traced Popen child pidfd; normal and emergency traced signals use that kernel identity. Proc PID/starttime/fourUID/actualELF sampling precedes requested signals.

When pidfd initialization itself fails, WNOWAIT checks the original still-unreaped child before the narrowly scoped PID fallback; ECHILD does not permit a PID signal. Actual reap or unconfirmed failure is retained.

source.needle: bounded owned TRACEME startup stop expired

static_checks.conclusion: Initial stop is observed with bounded WNOHANG wait; an early exited child has its raw wait status recorded and terminal() applied before refusal.

ABI is the UAPI layout: op0, audit-arch4, common union24; entry number24/arg0fd32; require80 entry bytes,33 exit bytes, native audit arch, retval0/is_error0. Buffer88 is sufficient for the largest union.
Only TRACEME/options/syscall continuation/clone scalar event/syscall-info are used; no register rewriting, PEEK/POKE, syscall substitution or return-value modification.
Stat follows the /proc FD magiclink itself; requires actual regular file. A separate resolved namespace lstat must match actual FD dev/ino, not substitute for it.
Original FD identity is re-observed while its one TID remains at the same syscall entry; no final name exists before release.

source.needle: held output stage does not match actual byte progress

static_checks.conclusion: Only the private generated partial file is selected: zero bytes for prepare fchmod, positive actual progress for file fsync. File mode0600/callerUID/singlelink are required.
Release is later than actual requested-signal forwarding by at least0.5s, not merely later than signal enqueue. Other traced TIDs continue so CLI cooperative stop can run.
Release resumes the same held TID; its next syscall exit records real signed retval and error bit. Required successful return is zero/noerror.
Known clone/exec events are separate from signal delivery. Parent/newborn order can vary; unmatched initial stops remain held until an actual clone message identifies them.

source.needle: unknown ptrace event; refusing to hide it

static_checks.conclusion: Unknown events fail closed; genuine eventcode0 SIGTRAP and other signals are forwarded. Unmatched SIGSTOP is held and cannot silently become a successful run.

source.needle: actual ptrace waitpid(__WALL) reaped original child

static_checks.conclusion: The tracer records leader terminal waitpid status and sets cached Popen returncode only from that actual terminal result. Its later run.wait is not represented as a second actual kernel wait.

source.needle: final artifact is not the originally held actual descriptor inode

static_checks.conclusion: The final or cancelled-partial receipt document must be the original held FD inode, with actual bytes/hash/mode/owner/nlink verified.
Gate exception is saved before finally; every emergency wait/resume/terminal/event-save operation is secondary-safe through run.collect.
Generic Popen polling is excluded for unresolved traced children, avoiding stop-as-exit confusion. Unconfirmed cleanup and forced cleanup latch FAIL, never cooperative PASS.

Backpressure case fills an otherwise blocking4096-byte pipe, keeps the reader open, waits for actual process exit1 before draining, then checks exactly the padding and EOF. File remains complete despite receipt delivery failure.
RLIMIT_FSIZE16 plus child-only ignored SIGXFSZ requires actual EFBIG/16-byte receipt and matching retained prefix digest, with no final destination.
The deliberate malformed log fixture is distinct from archived original logs; diagnostic output must remain valid incomplete JSON and omit both marker strings.
Existing bytes/inode/metadata and symlink-parent refusal are checked without silently removing or repairing targets.

Before/after repository support inventory and selected prebuilt ELF are compared; no build or feature inference is performed. Actual proc ELF may be unavailable for fast nontraced children and is not invented.

ast_parse: PASS; parse only, no module import/execution
optional_case: agent-unavailable is explicitly selected for a default-feature ELF only; it is not counted in default8 or inferred from --skip-build.
source_inventory_scope: support.sources scans crate Rust/TOML and vendor files plus Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock and support scripts; own diagnostic_runner is added. This is its stated prebuilt-runtime inventory, not a claim that an independent software/check/toolchain manifest is identical.
runtime_limits: Actual root first execution remains pending. AST/source checks are not ptrace/runtime or kernel-version acceptance.
Held fchmod/fsync is a removable syscall-entry stop before kernel execution, not kernel-internal hardblock or USB-driver concurrency proof.
Only observed own-child actual terminal status is reaping evidence. Forced cleanup/unconfirmed is FAIL. Descendant processes are not generally covered by this harness signal identity.
Full stdout/no-drain assertion belongs to the backpressure case. Ordinary bounded-receipt commands use communicate; they are not claimed as no-drain tests.
Fast nontraced child /proc identity can be absent; selected argv and before/after ELF only do not become per-child sampled-ELF proof.
The source helper inventory is distinct from full software evidence. No diagnostics/subprocess count is a USB/hardware case count.
